scope: Read-only analysis of existing source and isolated recorded evidence; no tests, source edits, lib edits, production actions, or new measurements.

normalAlreadyUpgradedSchema5.condition: Five independent process starts from verified fixed schema5 snapshot; real candidate reader/writer; frozen metadata; source reads denied; OS disk cache uncontrolled.

firstCompatibilityIndexInstallation.verdict: First compatibility-index installation plus cold requests did not meet 10 seconds; keep separate from normal upgraded-schema5 acceptance.

timing.publicReadyDefinition: performance.now() since public apply activation until ordinary status shows inactive, FTS available, 331 sessions, zero dirty checkpoints, and a positive dirtySessionsObservedAt; not only the FtsClient ready handshake.
timing.clockBoundary: Actor elapsed/updatedAt are recorded parent Date.now observations. Migration progress.at/elapsedMs come from the child. publicReadyMs uses performance.now from apply activation; no absolute performance/date anchor is recorded. Do not subtract these independent origins to invent an exact public-ready residual.

completeToWriterReady.established: Migration complete is emitted after COMMIT; no schema/workspace/chunk/index migration runs after that complete callback in this initialization path.

source.claim: telemetry uses process.memoryUsage and in-memory stage counters.

possibleOperations.operation: Initial writer health snapshot: two COUNT queries, four state_meta point queries, synchronous database stat

completeToWriterReady.attribution: Existing startup events measure only the aggregate complete-to-ready interval. Initial health/SQL/telemetry/IPC/scheduling cannot be individually assigned the 2884 ms; do not infer I/O faults or data corruption.

migrationCostBoundary.necessaryExpressionIndex: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_source_order ON messages(session_file,COALESCE(event_seq,id),id) establishes the SCROLL expression order. It is created once, and current schema5 with the index returns before DDL.
migrationCostBoundary.version5OnlyInference: The recorded first round contains schema/complete but no workspace/chunks progress. This is consistent with a schema5 compatibility-index-only upgrade; the code gates workspace/chunk rebuilding on version !=5. It does not prove per-statement timing.
migrationCostBoundary.clearRedundantWork: The shared migration path issues CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS messages_fts_trigram_insert/delete and later unconditionally drops both triggers. Their creation has no lasting effect for chunk-writing schema5. Schema/table/column checks and other IF NOT EXISTS DDL also run before the one expression index is installed.
optionalFutureChanges: A separately validated schema5-only migration branch could retain transaction locking/recheck and install only the missing expression index, avoiding unrelated IF NOT EXISTS DDL and transient trigram trigger creation/deletion.

Initial ready health snapshot followed by status polling repeats exact health SQL; an independently validated cached/deferred startup snapshot strategy could reduce duplicate work while preserving truthful health and status behavior.

Normal five-round acceptance covers fixed upgraded schema5 and independent processes with uncontrolled OS cache, frozen metadata and denied source parsing; it is not a throughput measurement for actual source scanning/building.
